technique: Support on parallel bars with locked elbows; lean slightly forward for chest emphasis or stay more upright for triceps.
Descend by bending the elbows until upper arms approach parallel to the floor (or a pain-free depth), then press to lockout.
setup: Bars stable; shoulders packed down; avoid end-range extension if symptomatic.
breathing: Inhale on the descent; exhale to press.
commonMistakes: Dumping into painful end-range shoulder extension
safety: Limit depth to avoid end-range glenohumeral extension when irritable (McKenzie et al. 2020).
Use assistance before adding load; stop with anterior shoulder pain.

bodyweightFraction.rationale: Feet free; almost all BM is supported through the upper limbs. Hands contact the bars (~1.2% BM per de Leva male hands), so estimate ~0.96–0.99. No published GRF %BM for dips found — estimate only.
